25: 26: ## Introduction 27: 28: MindCV is an open-source toolbox for computer vision research and development based on [MindSpore](https://www.mindspore.cn/en). It collects a series of classic and SoTA vision models, such as ResNet and SwinTransformer, along with their pre-trained weights and training strategies. SoTA methods such as auto augmentation are also provided for performance improvement. With the decoupled module design, it is easy to apply or adapt MindCV to your own CV tasks. 29: 30: The following is the corresponding `mindcv` versions and supported `mindspore` versions. 31: 32: | mindcv | mindspore | 33: | :----: | :---------: | 34: | main | master | 35: | 0.5 | 2.5.0 | 36: | 0.4 | 2.3.0/2.3.1 | 37: | 0.3 | 2.2.10 | 38: | 0.2 | 2.0 | 39: | 0.1 | 1.8 | 40: 41: ### Major Features 42: 43: - **Easy-to-Use.** MindCV decomposes the vision framework into various configurable components. It is easy to customize your data pipeline, models, and learning pipeline with MindCV: 44: 45: ```pycon 46: >>> import mindcv 47: # create a dataset 48: >>> dataset = mindcv.create_dataset('cifar10', download=True) 49: # create a model 50: >>> network = mindcv.create_model('resnet50', pretrained=True) 51: ``` 52: 53: Users can customize and launch their transfer learning or training task in one command line. 54: 55: ```shell 56: # transfer learning in one command line 57: python train.py --model=swin_tiny --pretrained --opt=adamw --lr=0.001 --data_dir=/path/to/data 58: ``` 59: 60: - **State-of-The-Art.** MindCV provides various CNN-based and Transformer-based vision models including SwinTransformer. Their pretrained weights and performance reports are provided to help users select and reuse the right model: 61: 62: - **Flexibility and efficiency.** MindCV is built on MindSpore which is an efficient DL framework that can be run on different hardware platforms (GPU/CPU/Ascend). It supports both graph mode for high efficiency and pynative mode for flexibility. 63: 64: ## Model Zoo 65: 66: The performance of the models trained with MindCV is summarized in [here](https://mindspore-lab.github.io/mindcv/modelzoo/), where the training recipes and weights are both available. 67: 68: Model introduction and training details can be viewed in each sub-folder under [configs](configs). 69: 70: ## Installation 71: 72: See [Installation](https://mindspore-lab.github.io/mindcv/installation/) for details. 73: 74: ## Getting Started 75: 76: ### Hands-on Tutorial 77: 78: To get started with MindCV, please see the [Quick Start](docs/en/tutorials/quick_start.md), which will give you a quick tour on each key component and the train/validate/predict pipelines. 79: 80: Below are a few code snippets for your taste. 1: """ Model training pipeline """
2: import logging
3: import os
4: 
5: import mindspore as ms
6: from mindspore import Tensor
7: from mindspore.communication import get_group_size, get_rank, init
8: 
9: from mindcv.data import create_dataset, create_loader, create_transforms
10: from mindcv.loss import create_loss
11: from mindcv.models import create_model
12: from mindcv.optim import create_optimizer
13: from mindcv.scheduler import create_scheduler
14: from mindcv.utils import (
15:     AllReduceSum,
16:     StateMonitor,
17:     create_trainer,
18:     get_metrics,
19:     require_customized_train_step,
20:     set_logger,
21:     set_seed,
22: )
23: 
24: from config import parse_args, save_args  # isort: skip
25: 
26: logger = logging.getLogger("mindcv.train")
27: 
28: 
29: def main():
30:     args = parse_args()
31:     ms.set_context(mode=args.mode)
32:     if args.mode == ms.GRAPH_MODE:
33:         ms.set_context(jit_config={"jit_level": "O2"})
34:     if args.distribute:
35:         init()
36:         rank_id, device_num = get_rank(), get_group_size()
37:         ms.set_auto_parallel_context(
38:             device_num=device_num,
39:             parallel_mode="data_parallel",
40:             gradients_mean=True,
41:             # we should but cannot set parameter_broadcast=True, which will cause error on gpu.
42:         )
43:         all_reduce = AllReduceSum()
44:     else:
45:         rank_id, device_num = None, None
46:         all_reduce = None
47: 
48:     set_seed(args.seed)
49:     set_logger(name="mindcv", output_dir=args.ckpt_save_dir, rank=rank_id, color=False)
50:     logger.info(
51:         "We recommend installing `termcolor` via `pip install termcolor` "
52:         "and setup logger by `set_logger(..., color=True)`"
53:     )
54: 
55:     # create dataset
56:     dataset_train = create_dataset(
57:         name=args.dataset,
58:         root=args.data_dir,
59:         split=args.train_split,
60:         shuffle=args.shuffle,
61:         num_samples=args.num_samples,
62:         num_shards=device_num,
63:         shard_id=rank_id,
64:         num_parallel_workers=args.num_parallel_workers,
65:         download=args.dataset_download,
66:         num_aug_repeats=args.aug_repeats,
67:     )
68:     if args.num_classes is None:
69:         num_classes = dataset_train.num_classes()
70:     else:
71:         num_classes = args.num_classes
72: 
73:     # create transforms
74:     num_aug_splits = 0
75:     if args.aug_splits > 0:
76:         assert args.aug_splits == 3, "Currently, only support 3 splits of augmentation"
77:         assert args.auto_augment is not None, "aug_splits should be set with one auto_augment"
78:         num_aug_splits = args.aug_splits
79:     transform_list = create_transforms(
80:         dataset_name=args.dataset,
81:         is_training=True,
82:         image_resize=args.image_resize,
83:         scale=args.scale,
84:         ratio=args.ratio,
85:         hflip=args.hflip,
86:         vflip=args.vflip,
87:         color_jitter=args.color_jitter,
88:         interpolation=args.interpolation,
89:         auto_augment=args.auto_augment,
90:         mean=args.mean,
91:         std=args.std,
92:         re_prob=args.re_prob,
93:         re_scale=args.re_scale,
94:         re_ratio=args.re_ratio,
95:         re_value=args.re_value,
96:         re_max_attempts=args.re_max_attempts,
97:         separate=num_aug_splits > 0,
98:     )
99: 
100:     # load dataset
101:     loader_train = create_loader(
102:         dataset=dataset_train,
103:         batch_size=args.batch_size,
104:         drop_remainder=args.drop_remainder,
105:         is_training=True,
106:         mixup=args.mixup,
107:         cutmix=args.cutmix,
108:         cutmix_prob=args.cutmix_prob,
109:         num_classes=num_classes,
110:         transform=transform_list,
111:         num_parallel_workers=args.num_parallel_workers,
112:         separate=num_aug_splits > 0,
113:     )
114:     num_batches = loader_train.get_dataset_size()
115:     train_count = dataset_train.get_dataset_size()
116:     if args.distribute:
117:         train_count = all_reduce(Tensor(train_count, ms.int32))
118: 
119:     if args.val_while_train:
120:         dataset_eval = create_dataset(
121:             name=args.dataset,
122:             root=args.data_dir,
123:             split=args.val_split,
124:             num_shards=device_num,
125:             shard_id=rank_id,
126:             num_parallel_workers=args.num_parallel_workers,
127:             download=args.dataset_download,
128:         )
129: 
130:         transform_list_eval = create_transforms(
131:             dataset_name=args.dataset,
132:             is_training=False,
133:             image_resize=args.image_resize,
134:             crop_pct=args.crop_pct,
135:             interpolation=args.interpolation,
136:             mean=args.mean,
137:             std=args.std,
138:         )
139: 
140:         loader_eval = create_loader(
141:             dataset=dataset_eval,
142:             batch_size=args.batch_size,
143:             drop_remainder=False,
144:             is_training=False,
145:             transform=transform_list_eval,
146:             num_parallel_workers=args.num_parallel_workers,
147:         )
148:         eval_count = dataset_eval.get_dataset_size()
149:         if args.distribute:
150:             eval_count = all_reduce(Tensor(eval_count, ms.int32))
151:     else:
152:         loader_eval = None
153:         eval_count = None
154: 
155:     # create model
156:     network = create_model(
157:         model_name=args.model,
158:         num_classes=num_classes,
159:         in_channels=args.in_channels,
160:         drop_rate=args.drop_rate,
161:         drop_path_rate=args.drop_path_rate,
162:         pretrained=args.pretrained,
163:         checkpoint_path=args.ckpt_path,
164:         ema=args.ema,
165:     )
166:     num_params = sum([param.size for param in network.get_parameters()])
167: 
168:     # create loss
169:     loss = create_loss(
170:         name=args.loss,
171:         reduction=args.reduction,
172:         label_smoothing=args.label_smoothing,
173:         aux_factor=args.aux_factor,
174:     )
175: 
176:     # create learning rate schedule
177:     lr_scheduler = create_scheduler(
178:         num_batches,
179:         scheduler=args.scheduler,
180:         lr=args.lr,
181:         min_lr=args.min_lr,
182:         warmup_epochs=args.warmup_epochs,
183:         warmup_factor=args.warmup_factor,
184:         decay_epochs=args.decay_epochs,
185:         decay_rate=args.decay_rate,
186:         milestones=args.multi_step_decay_milestones,
187:         num_epochs=args.epoch_size,
188:         num_cycles=args.num_cycles,
189:         cycle_decay=args.cycle_decay,
190:         lr_epoch_stair=args.lr_epoch_stair,
191:     )
192: 
193:     # resume training if ckpt_path is given
194:     if args.ckpt_path != "" and args.resume_opt:
195:         opt_ckpt_path = os.path.join(args.ckpt_save_dir, f"optim_{args.model}.ckpt")
196:     else:
197:         opt_ckpt_path = ""
198: 
199:     # create optimizer
200:     # TODO: consistent naming opt, name, dataset_name
201:     if (
202:         args.loss_scale_type == "fixed"
203:         and args.drop_overflow_update is False
204:         and not require_customized_train_step(
205:             args.ema,
206:             args.clip_grad,
207:             args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
208:             args.amp_cast_list,
209:         )
210:     ):
211:         optimizer_loss_scale = args.loss_scale
212:     else:
213:         optimizer_loss_scale = 1.0
214:     optimizer = create_optimizer(
215:         network,
216:         opt=args.opt,
217:         lr=lr_scheduler,
218:         weight_decay=args.weight_decay,
219:         momentum=args.momentum,
220:         nesterov=args.use_nesterov,
221:         weight_decay_filter=args.weight_decay_filter,
222:         layer_decay=args.layer_decay,
223:         loss_scale=optimizer_loss_scale,
224:         checkpoint_path=opt_ckpt_path,
225:         eps=args.eps,
226:     )
227: 
228:     # define eval metrics.
229:     metrics = get_metrics(num_classes)
230: 
231:     # create trainer
232:     trainer = create_trainer(
233:         network,
234:         loss,
235:         optimizer,
236:         metrics,
237:         amp_level=args.amp_level,
238:         amp_cast_list=args.amp_cast_list,
239:         loss_scale_type=args.loss_scale_type,
240:         loss_scale=args.loss_scale,
241:         drop_overflow_update=args.drop_overflow_update,
242:         ema=args.ema,
243:         ema_decay=args.ema_decay,
244:         clip_grad=args.clip_grad,
245:         clip_value=args.clip_value,
246:         gradient_accumulation_steps=args.gradient_accumulation_steps,
247:     )
248: 
249:     # callback
250:     # save checkpoint, summary training loss
251:     # record val acc and do model selection if val dataset is available
252:     begin_step = 0
253:     begin_epoch = 0
254:     if args.ckpt_path != "":
255:         begin_step = optimizer.global_step.asnumpy()[0]
256:         begin_epoch = args.ckpt_path.split("/")[-1].split("-")[1].split("_")[0]
257:         begin_epoch = int(begin_epoch)
258: 
259:     summary_dir = f"./{args.ckpt_save_dir}/summary"
260:     assert (
261:         args.ckpt_save_policy != "top_k" or args.val_while_train is True
262:     ), "ckpt_save_policy is top_k, val_while_train must be True."
263:     state_cb = StateMonitor(
264:         trainer,
265:         model_name=args.model,
266:         model_ema=args.ema,
267:         last_epoch=begin_epoch,
268:         dataset_sink_mode=args.dataset_sink_mode,
269:         dataset_val=loader_eval,
270:         metric_name=list(metrics.keys()),
271:         val_interval=args.val_interval,
272:         ckpt_save_dir=args.ckpt_save_dir,
273:         ckpt_save_interval=args.ckpt_save_interval,
274:         ckpt_save_policy=args.ckpt_save_policy,
275:         ckpt_keep_max=args.keep_checkpoint_max,
276:         summary_dir=summary_dir,
277:         log_interval=args.log_interval,
278:         rank_id=rank_id,
279:         device_num=device_num,
280:     )
281: 
282:     callbacks = [state_cb]
283:     essential_cfg_msg = "\n".join(
284:         [
285:             "Essential Experiment Configurations:",
286:             f"MindSpore mode[GRAPH(0)/PYNATIVE(1)]: {args.mode}",
287:             f"Distributed mode: {args.distribute}",
288:             f"Number of devices: {device_num if device_num is not None else 1}",
289:             f"Number of training samples: {train_count}",
290:             f"Number of validation samples: {eval_count}",
291:             f"Number of classes: {num_classes}",
292:             f"Number of batches: {num_batches}",
293:             f"Batch size: {args.batch_size}",
294:             f"Auto augment: {args.auto_augment}",
295:             f"MixUp: {args.mixup}",
296:             f"CutMix: {args.cutmix}",
297:             f"Model: {args.model}",
298:             f"Model parameters: {num_params}",
299:             f"Number of epochs: {args.epoch_size}",
300:             f"Optimizer: {args.opt}",
301:             f"Learning rate: {args.lr}",
302:             f"LR Scheduler: {args.scheduler}",
303:             f"Momentum: {args.momentum}",
304:             f"Weight decay: {args.weight_decay}",
305:             f"Auto mixed precision: {args.amp_level}",
306:             f"Loss scale: {args.loss_scale}({args.loss_scale_type})",
307:         ]
308:     )
309:     logger.info(essential_cfg_msg)
310:     save_args(args, os.path.join(args.ckpt_save_dir, f"{args.model}.yaml"), rank_id)
311: 
312:     if args.ckpt_path != "":
313:         logger.info(f"Resume training from {args.ckpt_path}, last step: {begin_step}, last epoch: {begin_epoch}")
314:     else:
315:         logger.info("Start training")
316: 
317:     trainer.train(args.epoch_size, loader_train, callbacks=callbacks, dataset_sink_mode=args.dataset_sink_mode)
318: 
319: 
320: if __name__ == "__main__":
321:     main()

def create_loader(
    dataset,
    batch_size,
    drop_remainder=False,
    is_training=False,
    mixup=0.0,
    cutmix=0.0,
    cutmix_prob=0.0,
    num_classes=1000,
    transform=None,
    target_transform=None,
    num_parallel_workers=None,
    python_multiprocessing=False,
    separate=False,
):
    r"""Creates dataloader.

    Applies operations such as transform and batch to the `ms.dataset.Dataset` object
    created by the `create_dataset` function to get the dataloader.

    Args:
        dataset (ms.dataset.Dataset): dataset object created by `create_dataset`.
        batch_size (int or function): The number of rows each batch is created with. An
            int or callable object which takes exactly 1 parameter, BatchInfo.
        drop_remainder (bool, optional): Determines whether to drop the last block
            whose data row number is less than batch size (default=False). If True, and if there are less
            than batch_size rows available to make the last batch, then those rows will
            be dropped and not propagated to the child node.
        is_training (bool): whether it is in train mode. Default: False.

22: def init_group_params(params, weight_decay, weight_decay_filter, no_weight_decay):
23:     if weight_decay_filter == "disable":
24:         return [
25:             {"params": params, "weight_decay": weight_decay},
26:             {"order_params": params},
27:         ]
28: 
29:     decay_params = []
30:     no_decay_params = []
31:     no_weight_decay = set(no_weight_decay)
32:     for param in params:
33:         if "beta" in param.name or "gamma" in param.name or "bias" in param.name or param.name in no_weight_decay:
34:             no_decay_params.append(param)
35:         else:
36:             decay_params.append(param)
37:     return [
38:         {"params": decay_params, "weight_decay": weight_decay},
39:         {"params": no_decay_params, "weight_decay": 0.0},
40:         {"order_params": params},
41:     ]

44: def param_groups_layer_decay(
45:     model: nn.Cell,
46:     lr: Optional[float] = 1e-3,
47:     weight_decay: float = 0.05,
48:     no_weight_decay_list: Tuple[str] = (),
49:     layer_decay: float = 0.75,
50: ):
51:     """
52:     Parameter groups for layer-wise lr decay & weight decay
53:     """
54:     no_weight_decay_list = set(no_weight_decay_list)
55:     param_group_names = {}  # NOTE for debugging
56:     param_groups = {}
57:     if hasattr(model, "group_matcher"):
58:         layer_map = group_with_matcher(model.trainable_params(), model.group_matcher(coarse=False), reverse=True)
59:     else:
60:         layer_map = _layer_map(model)
61: 
62:     num_layers = max(layer_map.values()) + 1
63:     layer_max = num_layers - 1
64:     layer_scales = list(layer_decay ** (layer_max - i) for i in range(num_layers))
65: 
66:     for name, param in model.parameters_and_names():
67:         if not param.requires_grad:
68:             continue
69: 
70:         # no decay: all 1D parameters and model specific ones
71:         if param.ndim == 1 or name in no_weight_decay_list:
72:             g_decay = "no_decay"
73:             this_decay = 0.0
74:         else:
75:             g_decay = "decay"
76:             this_decay = weight_decay
77: 
78:         layer_id = layer_map.get(name, layer_max)
79:         group_name = "layer_%d_%s" % (layer_id, g_decay)
80: 
81:         if group_name not in param_groups:
82:             this_scale = layer_scales[layer_id]
83:             param_group_names[group_name] = {
84:                 "lr": [learning_rate * this_scale for learning_rate in lr],
85:                 "weight_decay": this_decay,
86:                 "param_names": [],
87:             }
88:             param_groups[group_name] = {
89:                 "lr": [learning_rate * this_scale for learning_rate in lr],
90:                 "weight_decay": this_decay,
91:                 "params": [],
92:             }
93: 
94:         param_group_names[group_name]["param_names"].append(name)
95:         param_groups[group_name]["params"].append(param)
96: 
97:     return list(param_groups.values())
98: 
99: 
100: MATCH_PREV_GROUP = (99999,)
101: 
102: 
103: def group_with_matcher(
104:     named_objects: Iterator[Tuple[str, Any]], group_matcher: Union[Dict, Callable], reverse: bool = False
105: ):
106:     if isinstance(group_matcher, dict):
107:         # dictionary matcher contains a dict of raw-string regex expr that must be compiled
108:         compiled = []
109:         for group_ordinal, (_, mspec) in enumerate(group_matcher.items()):
110:             if mspec is None:
111:                 continue
112:             # map all matching specifications into 3-tuple (compiled re, prefix, suffix)
113:             if isinstance(mspec, (tuple, list)):
114:                 # multi-entry match specifications require each sub-spec to be a 2-tuple (re, suffix)
115:                 for sspec in mspec:
116:                     compiled += [(re.compile(sspec[0]), (group_ordinal,), sspec[1])]
117:             else:
118:                 compiled += [(re.compile(mspec), (group_ordinal,), None)]
119:         group_matcher = compiled
120: 
121:     def _get_grouping(name):
122:         if isinstance(group_matcher, (list, tuple)):
123:             for match_fn, prefix, suffix in group_matcher:
124:                 r = match_fn.match(name)
125:                 if r:
126:                     parts = (prefix, r.groups(), suffix)
127:                     # map all tuple elem to int for numeric sort, filter out None entries
128:                     return tuple(map(float, chain.from_iterable(filter(None, parts))))
129:             return (float("inf"),)  # un-matched layers (neck, head) mapped to largest ordinal
130:         else:
131:             ord = group_matcher(name)
132:             if not isinstance(ord, collections.abc.Iterable):
133:                 return (ord,)
134:             return tuple(ord)
135: 
136:     grouping = defaultdict(list)
137:     for param in named_objects:
138:         grouping[_get_grouping(param.name)].append(param.name)
139:     # remap to integers
140:     layer_id_to_param = defaultdict(list)
141:     lid = -1
142:     for k in sorted(filter(lambda x: x is not None, grouping.keys())):
143:         if lid < 0 or k[-1] != MATCH_PREV_GROUP[0]:
144:             lid += 1
145:         layer_id_to_param[lid].extend(grouping[k])
146: 
147:     if reverse:
148:         # output reverse mapping
149:         param_to_layer_id = {}
150:         for lid, lm in layer_id_to_param.items():
151:             for n in lm:
152:                 param_to_layer_id[n] = lid
153:         return param_to_layer_id
154: 
155:     return layer_id_to_param
156:

158: def _group(it, size):
159:     it = iter(it)
160:     return iter(lambda: tuple(islice(it, size)), ())
161:

163: def _layer_map(model, layers_per_group=12, num_groups=None):
164:     def _in_head(n, hp):
165:         if not hp:
166:             return True
167:         elif isinstance(hp, (tuple, list)):
168:             return any([n.startswith(hpi) for hpi in hp])
169:         else:
170:             return n.startswith(hp)
171: 
172:     # attention: need to add pretrained_cfg attr to model
173:     head_prefix = getattr(model, "pretrained_cfg", {}).get("classifier", None)
174:     names_trunk = []
175:     names_head = []
176:     for n, _ in model.parameters_and_names():
177:         names_head.append(n) if _in_head(n, head_prefix) else names_trunk.append(n)
178: 
179:     # group non-head layers
180:     num_trunk_layers = len(names_trunk)
181:     if num_groups is not None:
182:         layers_per_group = -(num_trunk_layers // -num_groups)
183:     names_trunk = list(_group(names_trunk, layers_per_group))
184:     num_trunk_groups = len(names_trunk)
185:     layer_map = {n: i for i, l in enumerate(names_trunk) for n in l}
186:     layer_map.update({n: num_trunk_groups for n in names_head})
187:     return layer_map

190: def create_optimizer(
191:     model_or_params,
192:     opt: str = "adam",
193:     lr: Optional[float] = 1e-3,
194:     weight_decay: float = 0,
195:     momentum: float = 0.9,
196:     nesterov: bool = False,
197:     weight_decay_filter: str = "disable",
198:     layer_decay: Optional[float] = None,
199:     loss_scale: float = 1.0,
200:     schedule_decay: float = 4e-3,
201:     checkpoint_path: str = "",
202:     eps: float = 1e-10,
203:     **kwargs,
204: ):
205:     r"""Creates optimizer by name.
206: 
207:     Args:
208:         model_or_params: network or network parameters. Union[list[Parameter],list[dict], nn.Cell], which must be
209:             the list of parameters or list of dicts or nn.Cell. When the list element is a dictionary, the key of
210:             the dictionary can be "params", "lr", "weight_decay","grad_centralization" and "order_params".
211:         opt: wrapped optimizer. You could choose like 'sgd', 'nesterov', 'momentum', 'adam', 'adamw', 'lion',
212:             'rmsprop', 'adagrad', 'lamb'. 'adam' is the default choose for convolution-based networks.
213:             'adamw' is recommended for ViT-based networks. Default: 'adam'.
214:         lr: learning rate: float or lr scheduler. Fixed and dynamic learning rate are supported. Default: 1e-3.
215:         weight_decay: weight decay factor. It should be noted that weight decay can be a constant value or a Cell.
216:             It is a Cell only when dynamic weight decay is applied. Dynamic weight decay is similar to
217:             dynamic learning rate, users need to customize a weight decay schedule only with global step as input,
218:             and during training, the optimizer calls the instance of WeightDecaySchedule to get the weight decay value
219:             of current step. Default: 0.
220:         momentum: momentum if the optimizer supports. Default: 0.9.
221:         nesterov: Whether to use Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (NAG) algorithm to update the gradients. Default: False.
222:         weight_decay_filter: filters to filter parameters from weight_decay.
223:             - "disable": No parameters to filter.
224:             - "auto": We do not apply weight decay filtering to any parameters. However, MindSpore currently
225:                     automatically filters the parameters of Norm layer from weight decay.
226:             - "norm_and_bias": Filter the paramters of Norm layer and Bias from weight decay.
227:         layer_decay: for apply layer-wise learning rate decay.
228:         loss_scale: A floating point value for the loss scale, which must be larger than 0.0. Default: 1.0.
229: 
230:     Returns:
231:         Optimizer object
232:     """
233: 
234:     no_weight_decay = {}
235:     if isinstance(model_or_params, nn.Cell):
236:         # a model was passed in, extract parameters and add weight decays to appropriate layers
237:         if hasattr(model_or_params, "no_weight_decay"):
238:             no_weight_decay = model_or_params.no_weight_decay()
239:         params = model_or_params.trainable_params()
240: 
241:     else:
242:         params = model_or_params
243: 
244:     if weight_decay_filter == "auto":
245:         _logger.warning(
246:             "You are using AUTO weight decay filter, which means the weight decay filter isn't explicitly pass in "
247:             "when creating an mindspore.nn.Optimizer instance. "
248:             "NOTE: mindspore.nn.Optimizer will filter Norm parmas from weight decay. "
249:         )
250:     elif layer_decay is not None and isinstance(model_or_params, nn.Cell):
251:         params = param_groups_layer_decay(
252:             model_or_params,
253:             lr=lr,
254:             weight_decay=weight_decay,
255:             layer_decay=layer_decay,
256:             no_weight_decay_list=no_weight_decay,
257:         )
258:         weight_decay = 0.0
259:     elif weight_decay_filter == "disable" or "norm_and_bias":
260:         params = init_group_params(params, weight_decay, weight_decay_filter, no_weight_decay)
261:         weight_decay = 0.0
262:     else:
263:         raise ValueError(
264:             f"weight decay filter only support ['disable', 'auto', 'norm_and_bias'], but got{weight_decay_filter}."
265:         )
266: 
267:     opt = opt.lower()
268:     opt_args = dict(**kwargs)
269:     # if lr is not None:
270:     #    opt_args.setdefault('lr', lr)
271: 
272:     # non-adaptive: SGD, momentum, and nesterov
273:     if opt == "sgd":
274:         # note: nn.Momentum may perform better if momentum > 0.
275:         optimizer = nn.SGD(
276:             params=params,
277:             learning_rate=lr,
278:             momentum=momentum,
279:             weight_decay=weight_decay,
280:             nesterov=nesterov,
281:             loss_scale=loss_scale,
282:             **opt_args,
283:         )
284:     elif opt in ["momentum", "nesterov"]:
285:         optimizer = nn.Momentum(
286:             params=params,
287:             learning_rate=lr,
